title: Healthsheet: Development of a Transparency Artifact for Health Datasets
findings: The paper identifies religion as a sensitive demographic data point that is collected in some health datasets (e.g., MIMIC-III). The main finding is that the collection methods, rationale, and presence of such data must be transparently documented in a 'Healthsheet' to ensure responsible and equitable use of the data in ML applications, highlighting that current documentation practices are often inadequate.
